stages.name: Self test copy
stages.description: A self test that copies frames unchanged and reimplements nothing.

params.name: Shift Y

layers.description: A key file with a value per frame for shift_x and shift_y.

stages.name: Resample scale
stages.description: Resamples each frame to a given width and height with a selectable reconstruction filter (nearest, bilinear, Keys cubic, Mitchell and Netravali cubic, Lanczos or box) under an explicit border, pixel centre, alpha and normalisation rule. A generic stage: a published method under explicit configuration, not compared with any product.

params.name: Levels
params.description: The integer depth of the grid the samples are snapped to.

params.name: 16 bit full scale
params.description: The integer that stands for full scale on the 16 bit grid (Config::u16_max); read when levels is 16.

params.name: Rounding
params.description: How a real number becomes an integer (Config::rounding).

params.name: Precision
params.description: The floating point type of the arithmetic (Config::precision).

params.name: Clamp
params.description: What happens to a rounded value outside the grid or to a value that is not a number (Config::clamp).

stages.name: Depth quantise
stages.description: Snaps every sample of each frame to the values of an 8 bit or 16 bit integer grid, by a conversion to that depth and back under an explicit rounding, precision and clamp rule; the stream keeps its depth. A generic stage: a published method under explicit configuration, not compared with any product.

params.name: Operation
params.description: Whether colour is multiplied by alpha or divided by it (AlphaOp).

params.name: Rounding
params.description: How a real number becomes an integer (Config::rounding).

params.name: Precision
params.description: The floating point type of the arithmetic (Config::precision).

params.name: Clamp
params.description: What happens to a rounded value outside the range or to a value that is not a number (Config::clamp).

params.name: Zero alpha
params.description: What a division does where alpha is 0: the colour becomes 0, or stays (Config::zero_alpha).

params.name: Order
params.description: Whether the samples are converted before or after the alpha operation (Config::order).

stages.name: Alpha premultiply
stages.description: Multiplies the colour of each pixel by its alpha, or divides it by its alpha, under an explicit rounding, precision, clamp, zero alpha and order rule. The frame contract carries straight alpha: the output of op=premultiply is premultiplied and outside the contract until a later stage divides by alpha again. A generic stage: a published method under explicit configuration, not compared with any product.

params.name: Channels
params.description: Which channels are blurred: the alpha channel, or all four; the others pass.

params.name: Method
params.description: The blur: one box blur, passes box blurs in a row, or a Gaussian blur.

params.name: Radius
params.description: The box radius in samples, or the Gaussian sigma or radius as gauss_spec says; 0 is no blur; may be keyed.

params.name: Passes
params.description: The number of box blurs in a row; read when method is box-repeated.

params.name: Gaussian given by
params.description: Whether radius is the standard deviation of the Gaussian or a radius divided by radius_to_sigma (GaussSpec); read when method is gaussian.

params.name: Border
params.description: What a tap outside the frame reads (Config::border).

params.name: Fractional radius
params.description: How a box radius with a fraction becomes weights (Config::frac_rule).

params.name: Truncation
params.description: The Gaussian is cut at this many standard deviations (Config::trunc_k); the Gaussian needs a value above 0.

params.name: Exponential
params.description: How the Gaussian weights are evaluated (Config::exp_method).

params.name: Series terms
params.description: The number of terms of the exponential series (Config::exp_terms).

params.name: Radius to sigma
params.description: A Gaussian given by radius has sigma = radius / this value (Config::radius_to_sigma); it needs a value above 0.

layers.description: A key file with a value per frame for radius.

stages.name: Soft edge blur
stages.description: Blurs the alpha channel, or all four channels, of each frame with a separable box blur, a repeated box blur or a truncated Gaussian blur under an explicit border, fractional radius and kernel rule. A generic stage: a published method under explicit configuration, not compared with any product.

params.name: Width
params.description: The width of the ramp in samples of distance; at 0 the frame is written as it was read; may be keyed.

params.name: Profile
params.description: The shape of the ramp from 0 to 1 (Config::profile).

params.name: Direction
params.description: Which side of the contour the ramp lies on (Config::direction).

params.name: Threshold
params.description: A pixel is inside when its alpha is at least this value (Config::threshold).

params.name: Edge offset
params.description: The signed distance is the distance between sample centres minus this value (Config::edge_offset).

params.name: Border
params.description: Whether everything beyond the frame is outside (zero) or the frame border is no edge (Config::border).

layers.description: A key file with a value per frame for width.

stages.name: Soft edge feather
stages.description: Replaces the alpha channel of each frame by a linear, smoothstep or cosine ramp over the signed Euclidean distance to the contour where alpha crosses a threshold, inward, outward or centred on the contour; colour passes. A generic stage: a published method under explicit configuration, not compared with any product.

params.name: Maps
params.description: Which way the matrix goes: from an output position to the source position it reads, or from a source position to where it lands; the second is inverted before use.

params.name: Vector convention
params.description: Whether a point is a column vector (p' = M p) or a row vector (p' = p M) (Config::convention).

params.name: Divisor guard
params.description: What happens where the homogeneous divisor is not above divisor_min: the pixel is zero, the divisor is replaced by divisor_min, or the numerators are used undivided (Config::guard).

params.name: Divisor minimum
params.description: The divisor is valid when it is above this value (Config::divisor_min); with guard clamp it is also the value divided by.

params.name: Coordinates
params.description: Where the matrix acts: on pixel positions, or on the unit square of each frame.

params.name: Matrix pixel centre
params.description: Where pixel i has its centre in the pixel coordinates of the matrix: at i, or at i + 0.5 (Config::center).

params.name: Y axis
params.description: Whether v of the unit square grows down or up the rows; read when coords is unit (Config::y_axis).

params.name: Pixel aspect
params.description: The width of a pixel over its height; read when coords is pixel (Config::pixel_aspect).

params.name: Singular tolerance
params.description: The relative pivot tolerance of the four point solve (Config::singular_tolerance).

layers.description: A key file with a value per frame for the matrix entries m00 to m22.

stages.name: Planar warp
stages.description: Warps each frame by a planar projective transform given as a 3 by 3 matrix (Hartley and Zisserman 2003), sampled with a selectable reconstruction filter under explicit vector, divisor, coordinate and pixel centre rules. A generic stage: a published method under explicit configuration, not compared with any product.

stages.name: Four point warp
stages.description: Warps each frame by the planar projective transform that takes the four corners of a frame to four given points, solved by the direct linear transformation (Hartley and Zisserman 2003) and sampled with a selectable reconstruction filter. A generic stage: a published method under explicit configuration, not compared with any product.

params.name: Focal length in pixels
params.description: The divisor when normalisation is focal-length.

params.name: Centre x

params.name: Centre y

params.name: Model maps
params.description: Which way the formula of the model goes (Config::maps).

params.name: Inverse method
params.description: How the inverse of the formula is computed where the stage needs it (Config::inverse_method); closed-form exists for division only.

params.name: Inverse iterations
params.description: The fixed step count of the iterative inverse methods (Config::inverse_iterations).

layers.description: A key file with a value per frame for k1, k2, k3, p1, p2, lambda, centre_x and centre_y.

stages.name: Lens distortion warp
stages.description: Applies or removes a lens distortion on each frame with a radial polynomial model (Brown 1966, 1971), a division model (Fitzgibbon 2001) or a squeezed variant, sampled with a selectable reconstruction filter. A generic stage: a published method under explicit configuration, not compared with any product.

params.name: Longitude zero

params.name: Longitude direction

params.name: Column sample

params.name: Pole rows

params.name: North

params.name: Axis order

params.name: Angle sign

params.name: Matrix use

A generic stage: a published method under explicit configuration, not compared with any product.

stages.name: Mesh warp
stages.description: Warps each frame by a triangle mesh with barycentric interpolation inside each triangle (Wolberg 1990) under an explicit shared edge, outside, winding and degenerate triangle rule, sampled with a selectable reconstruction filter. A generic stage: a published method under explicit configuration, not compared with any product.

params.name: Carry
params.description: Which channels hold the matte: alpha (colour passes), luma (the three colour channels, alpha at full scale) or all four.

params.name: Apply
params.description: How the coverage meets the alpha of the input frame: it replaces it, multiplies it or the larger of the two is kept.

params.name: Method
params.description: How the coverage of a pixel is found: the exact area, one sample at the pixel centre, or the fraction of a sample pattern (Config::method).

params.name: Samples
params.description: The size of the sample pattern: samples-grid takes samples by samples points per pixel, samples-rotated takes samples points.

params.name: Fill rule
params.description: Which winding numbers count as inside (Config::fill).

params.name: Pixel centre
params.description: Pixel i has its centre at coordinate i + centre (Config::centre).

params.name: Rows grow with y
params.description: Whether row 0 of the frame is at the smallest y, or at the largest (Config::y_down).

params.name: Combine
params.description: How the coverages of several polygons become one plane, in file order (Config::combine).

params.name: Precision
params.description: Whether a coverage value stays a double or is rounded to single precision after each step (Config::precision).

params.name: Snap bits
params.description: 0 leaves coordinates as they are; n from 1 to 30 rounds every coordinate to a multiple of 2^-n first (Config::snap_bits).

params.name: Quantise
params.description: Whether the rasteriser converts the coverage to a code of the depth of the stream (Config::quantise).

params.name: Quantise scale
params.description: The factor from coverage 1 to a code: the largest value of the depth, or that value plus one; read when quantise is on (Quantise::scale).

params.name: Quantise rounding
params.description: How a scaled coverage becomes a whole code; read when quantise is on (Quantise::rounding).

params.name: Offset X
params.description: Added to the x of every point before the rasteriser runs, in pixels; may be keyed.

params.name: Offset Y
params.description: Added to the y of every point before the rasteriser runs, in pixels; may be keyed.

layers.description: The polygons to rasterise: rings of points in pixels of the frame. Without it nothing is covered.
A key file with a value per frame for offset_x and offset_y.

A generic stage: a published method under explicit configuration, not compared with any product.

params.description: Pixel i has its centre at coordinate i + centre (Config::centre).

params.name: Rows grow with y
params.description: Whether row 0 of the frame is at the smallest y, or at the largest (Config::y_down).

params.name: Combine
params.description: How the coverages of several polygons become one plane, in file order (Config::combine).

params.name: Precision
params.description: Whether a coverage value stays a double or is rounded to single precision after each step (Config::precision).

params.name: Snap bits
params.description: 0 leaves coordinates as they are; n from 1 to 30 rounds every coordinate to a multiple of 2^-n first (Config::snap_bits).

params.name: Quantise
params.description: Whether the rasteriser converts the coverage to a code of the depth of the stream (Config::quantise).

params.name: Quantise scale
params.description: The factor from coverage 1 to a code: the largest value of the depth, or that value plus one; read when quantise is on (Quantise::scale).

params.name: Quantise rounding
params.description: How a scaled coverage becomes a whole code; read when quantise is on (Quantise::rounding).

params.name: Offset X
params.description: Added to the x of every point before the rasteriser runs, in pixels; may be keyed.

params.name: Offset Y
params.description: Added to the y of every point before the rasteriser runs, in pixels; may be keyed.

params.name: Flatten
params.description: The rule that turns a span into segments: a fixed count, midpoint subdivision to a flatness bound, or a count from the length of the span (Flatten).

params.name: Segments
params.description: The segments per span; read when flatten is uniform (Flatten::Uniform).

params.name: Tolerance
params.description: The largest distance the flatness test accepts, in pixels; read when flatten is subdivide (Flatten::Subdivide tol).

params.name: Depth limit
params.description: The deepest subdivision; read when flatten is subdivide (Flatten::Subdivide max_depth).

params.name: Step
params.description: The length one segment stands for, in pixels; read when flatten is by-length (Flatten::ByLength step).

params.name: Length samples
params.description: The parameter steps of the length estimate of a span; read when flatten is by-length (Flatten::ByLength samples).

params.name: Evaluation form
params.description: The evaluation form of a cubic Bezier span (Config::form).

params.name: Evaluation precision
params.description: The number type inside an evaluation (Config::precision).

params.name: Tangents
params.description: Whether a Bezier tangent handle is an offset from its anchor or a position (Config::tangents).

params.name: Open end
params.description: How the ends of an open X-spline contour are extended (Config::open_end).

params.name: Closing span
params.description: Whether a closed contour has the span from its last point back to its first (Config::closing_span).

params.name: Repeat first
params.description: Whether the polyline of a closed contour ends with a copy of its first point (Config::repeat_first).

params.name: Flatness test
params.description: The flatness test of the subdivide rule; control-polygon takes Bezier contours only (Config::flat_test).

params.name: Weight map
params.description: The map from a stored X-spline weight w to the shape parameter: w, 2w - 1, w / 100 or w / 50 - 1 (Config::weight_map, the four maps of Config::WEIGHT_MAPS).

layers.description: The contours to rasterise: cubic Bezier or X-spline control points in pixels of the frame. Without it nothing is covered.
A key file with a value per frame for offset_x and offset_y.

stages.name: Raster contour
stages.description: Flattens cubic Bezier and X-spline contours (Farin 2002; Blanc and Schlick 1995) from a shape file to polylines under an explicit flattening rule and evaluation configuration, rasterises them to a coverage matte as raster-polygon does, and carries the matte in the frame as the carry parameter says. A generic stage: a published method under explicit configuration, not compared with any product.

params.name: Data file
params.description: The path of the key file the stage writes (form keys-1, tracks m00 to m22, one linear key per frame); empty writes none.

params.name: Report file
params.description: The path of a table the stage writes with one row per frame (source, stop reason, iterations, residual, valid and inlier fractions, gain, offset); empty writes none.

params.name: Corner 0 X
params.description: One coordinate of a corner of the tracked region on the reference frame, in pixels with the centre of the first pixel at 0; the four corners go around the boundary, and when all eight values are 0 the region is the whole frame.

params.name: Corner 0 Y
params.description: One coordinate of a corner of the tracked region on the reference frame, in pixels with the centre of the first pixel at 0; the four corners go around the boundary, and when all eight values are 0 the region is the whole frame.

params.name: Corner 1 X
params.description: One coordinate of a corner of the tracked region on the reference frame, in pixels with the centre of the first pixel at 0; the four corners go around the boundary, and when all eight values are 0 the region is the whole frame.

params.name: Corner 1 Y
params.description: One coordinate of a corner of the tracked region on the reference frame, in pixels with the centre of the first pixel at 0; the four corners go around the boundary, and when all eight values are 0 the region is the whole frame.

params.name: Corner 2 X
params.description: One coordinate of a corner of the tracked region on the reference frame, in pixels with the centre of the first pixel at 0; the four corners go around the boundary, and when all eight values are 0 the region is the whole frame.

params.name: Corner 2 Y
params.description: One coordinate of a corner of the tracked region on the reference frame, in pixels with the centre of the first pixel at 0; the four corners go around the boundary, and when all eight values are 0 the region is the whole frame.

params.name: Corner 3 X
params.description: One coordinate of a corner of the tracked region on the reference frame, in pixels with the centre of the first pixel at 0; the four corners go around the boundary, and when all eight values are 0 the region is the whole frame.

params.name: Corner 3 Y
params.description: One coordinate of a corner of the tracked region on the reference frame, in pixels with the centre of the first pixel at 0; the four corners go around the boundary, and when all eight values are 0 the region is the whole frame.

params.name: Reference frame
params.description: The index of the frame that holds the region; its pose is the identity. Frames before it wait in memory until it has been read.

params.name: Grey weight R
params.description: The weight of R in the grey level the tracker reads; the default weights are those of ITU-R BT.709.

params.name: Grey weight G
params.description: The weight of G in the grey level the tracker reads.

params.name: Grey weight B
params.description: The weight of B in the grey level the tracker reads.

params.name: Motion model
params.description: The degrees of freedom of the motion model (Config::dof).

params.name: Update rule
params.description: The warp update rule (Config::rule).

params.name: Illumination
params.description: The gain and offset model of the grey level (Config::illumination).

params.name: Damping
params.description: How the damping term is added to the normal matrix (LmConfig::damping).

params.name: Step acceptance
params.description: The test that accepts a trial step (LmConfig::acceptance).

params.name: Gain ratio
params.description: The least ratio of actual to predicted reduction; read when acceptance is gain-ratio. The crate has no default; 0 is this stage's.

params.name: Boundary weight
params.description: The weight of a region pixel from its distance to the outside of the region (SelectionConfig::boundary).

params.name: Boundary ramp
params.description: The distance in pixels at which the boundary weight reaches 1; read when boundary is not off. The crate has no default; 4 is this stage's.

params.name: Motion prediction
params.description: The first guess of a frame: the pose of its neighbour, or that pose moved once more by the last motion (Config::velocity).

params.name: Pyramid levels
params.description: The most levels of the pyramid (PyramidConfig::levels).

params.name: Pyramid scale
params.description: The size ratio between neighbouring levels, above 1 (PyramidConfig::scale).

params.name: Pyramid kernel taps
params.description: The taps of the binomial blur kernel, odd (PyramidConfig::kernel_taps).

params.name: Pyramid least size
params.description: A level narrower or lower than this is not built (PyramidConfig::min_size).

params.name: Lambda start
params.description: The damping at the start of every level (LmConfig::lambda_init).

params.name: Lambda up
params.description: The factor on the damping after a rejected step, above 1 (LmConfig::lambda_up).

params.name: Lambda down
params.description: The factor on the damping after an accepted step, above 0 (LmConfig::lambda_down).

params.name: Lambda floor
params.description: The damping is never lowered below this (LmConfig::lambda_min).

params.name: Iteration limit
params.description: The most steps of one level (LevelParams::max_iterations).

params.name: Rejection limit
params.description: The rejected steps in a row after which a level stops (LevelParams::max_rejections).

params.name: Step tolerance
params.description: A level stops when the largest corner motion of an accepted step is below this, in level pixels (LevelParams::step_tol).

params.name: Cost tolerance
params.description: A level stops when the relative fall of the cost in an accepted step is below this (LevelParams::cost_tol).

params.name: Lambda limit
params.description: A level stops when the damping exceeds this (LevelParams::lambda_max).

params.name: Selection fraction
params.description: The share of the region pixels kept, those of largest gradient, above 0 (SelectionConfig::min_fraction).

params.name: Weight floor
params.description: The floor of every pixel weight, above 0 (SelectionConfig::min_weight).

params.name: Border is outside
params.description: Whether the pixels beyond the frame edge count as outside the region in the distance transform (SelectionConfig::border_is_outside).

params.name: Coarse search
params.description: Whether a search by normalised cross correlation over whole pixel shifts runs before the registration (NccConfig::enabled).

params.name: Coarse search level
params.description: The pyramid level of the coarse search; -1 is the coarsest level in use (NccConfig::level).

params.name: Coarse search radius
params.description: The radius of the search window in pixels of that level (NccConfig::radius).

params.name: Coarse search step
params.description: The step of the window scan in pixels of that level (NccConfig::step).

params.name: Coarse search valid share
params.description: A shift is scored only when this share of the selected pixels falls inside the frame, above 0 (NccConfig::min_valid_fraction).

params.name: Coarse search least score
params.description: The best score must reach this for the shift to be taken (NccConfig::min_score).

params.name: Inlier threshold
params.description: A pixel is an inlier when its absolute residual is at most this, in grey units (Config::inlier_threshold).

params.name: Least valid pixels
params.description: A level is abandoned when fewer pixels than this fall inside the frame (Config::min_valid_pixels).

params.name: Refused frame
params.description: What a frame the tracker refuses does: hold keeps the pose of its neighbour towards the reference and says so in the report, fail ends the run as unsupported.

stages.name: Track planar
stages.description: Tracks a planar region through the frames by direct intensity based registration (the Lucas and Kanade family with Levenberg and Marquardt damping on a Gaussian pyramid), writes every frame as it was read and writes one pose per frame, a 3 by 3 matrix from the reference frame to that frame, to the key file named by data. A generic stage: a published method under explicit configuration, not compared with any product.
